_comment: Maps current PHMSA operator key (OPERATOR_ID_STOP) to predecessor keys that covered the same territory in earlier years. The build script backfills missing years from predecessor data. Edit this file to add/remove mappings, then re-run build_phmsa_timeseries_json.py.

40196_MA.note: Eversource Gas of Massachusetts (2020+). Formerly Columbia Gas of Massachusetts; NiSource sold the MA distribution business to Eversource in 2020 following the 2018 Merrimack Valley gas explosions.

32513_IL.note: AMEREN ILLINOIS COMPANY (IL, filings from 2010). Renamed/reorganized from ILLINOIS POWER CO (1997-2009); name match score 64 with nesting place tokens.

15359_WY.note: BLACK HILLS ENERGY (WY, filings from 2016). Renamed/reorganized from BLACK HILLS NORTHWEST WYOMING GAS UTILITY COMPANY, LLC (1997-2015); name match score 76 with nesting place tokens.

31636_MN.note: NORTHERN STATES POWER CO OF MINNESOTA (MN, filings from 2002). Renamed/reorganized from NORTHERN STATES POWER CO (1997-2001); name match score 100 with nesting place tokens.

31632_SD.note: NORTHWESTERN CORPORATION (SD, filings from 2012). Renamed/reorganized from NORTHWESTERN ENERGY LLC (1997-2011); name match score 69 with nesting place tokens.

31632_NE.note: NORTHWESTERN CORPORATION (NE, filings from 2012). Renamed/reorganized from NORTHWESTERN ENERGY LLC (1997-2011); name match score 69 with nesting place tokens.

31906_MN.note: NORTHWEST NATURAL GAS LLC (MN, filings from 2004). Renamed/reorganized from NORTHWEST NATURAL GAS CO (1997-2003); name match score 94 with nesting place tokens.

31357_MS.note: GEO PETROLEUM ENERGY TRANSMISSION LTD (MS, filings from 1999). Renamed/reorganized from GEO PETROLEUM ENERGY TRANSMISSION, LTD (1998-1998); name match score 99 with nesting place tokens.

31636_SD.note: NORTHERN STATES POWER COMPANY OF MINNESOTA (SD, filings from 2002). Renamed/reorganized from NORTHERN STATES POWER CO (1998-2001); name match score 93 with nesting place tokens.

30879_OH.note: GASCO DISTRIBUTION SYSTEMS, INC. (OH, filings from 1999). Renamed/reorganized from GASCO DISTRIBUTION SYSTEMS OF KY, INC. (1997-1997); name match score 89 with nesting place tokens.

31840_AZ.note: UniSource Energy Services AZ (2003+). Same operator renamed under a new PHMSA id; UniSource acquired Citizens Utilities Arizona gas assets in 2003.

15359_KS.note: Black Hills Energy KS (2007+). Fills the 1998-2006 gap from Aquila Networks (Kansas); Black Hills acquired Aquila Kansas gas distribution in 2008.

15518_TN.note: Piedmont Natural Gas TN (2007+). Nashville Gas Company is Piedmont Tennessee division under its former PHMSA id.

40400_RI.note: Rhode Island Energy (2022+). Four-stage lineage: Bristol & Warren Gas + Valley Gas + New England Gas consolidated into New England Gas in 2003 (mileage 2,380+593+85=3,058 matches the 3,056 filed that year, so 1997-2002 is correctly summed); National Grid then filed RI gas under the Niagara Mohawk operator id 2006-2021; PPL acquired it as Rhode Island Energy in 2022. Southern Union Gas 18532_RI is deliberately excluded as a duplicate of the New England Gas division.

39102_MD.note: Sandpiper Energy MD (2013+). Acquired the Eastern Shore Gas Company distribution systems in 2013 and converted them from propane to natural gas.

15359_AR.note: Black Hills Energy AR (2016+). Black Hills acquired SourceGas in 2016; continuity 0.98.

32198_MN.note: Minnesota Energy Resources (2006+). Aquila sold its Minnesota gas utility in 2006; continuity 0.99.

31470_OH.note: Vectren Energy Delivery of Ohio (2000+). Vectren acquired Dayton Power & Light natural gas business in 2000; continuity 0.99.

31349_MN.note: Fairfax, City of MN (1999+). Same town, formerly Fairfax Gas & Water System; continuity 1.00.

31808_WV.note: Canaan Valley Gas Co WV (2002+). Three-way merger of Town Gas, GASCO Distribution Systems and Ashford/Kenna Gas; their 1997-2001 shares (0.50+0.33+0.17) sum to exactly 1.00, so those years are summed.

38906_MO.note: Liberty Utilities (Midstates Natural Gas) MO (2012+). Liberty acquired the Atmos Missouri/Iowa/Illinois systems in 2012; continuity 1.00.

38906_IA.note: Liberty Utilities (Midstates Natural Gas) IA (2012+). Iowa side of the same 2012 Liberty/Atmos transaction; continuity 1.01.

38967_GA.note: Liberty Energy (Georgia) (2013+). Liberty acquired the Atmos Georgia system in 2013; continuity 1.06.

32647_OK.note: Navitas Utility Corporation OK (2012+). Formerly Fort Cobb Fuel Irrigation Authority, matching the existing manual EIA match; continuity 0.98.

31348_TX.note: Atmos Energy Mid-Tex (1999+). Lone Star Gas distribution division became TXU Gas and then Atmos Mid-Tex; continuity 0.99.

32397_OH.note: Glenwood Energy of Oxford OH (2007+). Formerly Oxford Natural Gas, same town; continuity 1.00.

31473_MS.note: Northeast Mississippi Natural Gas District (2000+). Verified: the district was created by the state legislature in 1961 as MANTACHIE Natural Gas District and later renamed Northeast Mississippi; source nemsnaturalgas.com history. Continuity 1.04. Williamsville Water Co was NOT included - no evidence it was part of this district.
